root_cause: Terminal closure traversed historical Supersedes metadata across an obligation boundary. PR #2509 pointed to #2504 from another obligation, causing migration lineage derivation to fail even though production readback for #2510 was already proven.
prevention: Terminal supersession traversal is scoped to one Obligation-ID.
Encountering a predecessor with another Obligation-ID is a terminal lineage boundary, not an error.
Cycles, malformed metadata, open predecessors and ambiguous migration identities remain fail-closed.
